risk_summary: The disclosure is highly quantified and provides detailed geographic, quarterly, and business-line performance data, but relies substantially on non-GAAP constant-currency measures and repeated COVID-19 explanations. Risk tone is materially negative due to significant revenue declines, margin pressure, restructuring costs, and continued pandemic uncertainty, although signs of recovery and resilient business areas are noted.
